purpose: Ephemeral fleet registry: template versions, vmid/IP pools, static reservations. Leases (dynamic) live in the runtime lease file, reconciled against observed PVE state.

templates.name: agent-runner-v1
templates.hygiene: clean: no secrets, no history, single cynic key, no host keys (first-boot regen)

ephemeral_pool.note: vhosts below 120 are hand-allocated history (101-119); never auto-allocate below 120

static_reservations.note: Never sweep, never allocate. Templates, infrastructure, siblings.
